name: Universal Entertainment
summary: Headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, Universal Entertainment Corporation specializes in the development, manufacturing, and distribution of Pachislot and Pachinko machines within the Japanese market. Its operations are primarily divided into two divisions: the Amusement Equipment Business and the Integrated Resort Business. Beyond core machine production, the company also innovates with peripheral systems for gaming parlors, such as Falcon X, and provides digital signage solutions like Hot Stadium. Furthermore, it maintains a members-only mobile portal, Universal Kingdom, and creates Pachislot simulation applications for smartphone users. In its integrated resort segment, Universal Entertainment oversees the operation of OKADA MANILA, a prominent casino resort located in the Philippines. Additionally, the corporation engages in real estate development initiatives. Established in 1969, the company adopted its current name, Universal Entertainment Corporation, in November 2009, having previously operated as Aruze Corp.
